steps.title: Populate a full durable-asset footprint (prediction, consultation, audit entry, webhook delivery) before backup
FULL inventory check against the RESTORED database (not just row counts — RLS and pgvector re-confirmed live)
Explicit non-DB asset disclosure (what this backup does NOT cover)

detail.model_binaries_joblib: NOT_RECOVERED by DB backup — SEPARATELY_RECOVERABLE via ops/non_db_recovery.py manifest (Workstream D)
detail.datasets_raw_csv: NOT_RECOVERED by DB backup — SEPARATELY_RECOVERABLE via ops/non_db_recovery.py manifest
detail.cms_binary_uploads: NOT_APPLICABLE — this deployment's CMS content is text/metadata in Postgres, no binary upload store exists
detail.secrets_configuration: NOT_RECOVERED by either mechanism — by design, secrets are never included in any backup or manifest
detail.application_logs: NOT_RECOVERED by either mechanism — logs are not treated as a durable recovery asset in this design
